request:
Run zero-copy-requirements on this. I am finishing a change that adds a report export and have five notes. Place each one, in one line each: name the exact artifact it goes in, and what to do with it now.

1. I chose a streaming writer over a buffered one. It is easy to swap later and changes nothing about what users see, privacy, or cost.
2. We could put the export behind the paid plan. That changes what users see and what they pay.
3. While reading nearby code I noticed an ugly helper in another module. It works. I was going to open an issue so we do not forget it.
4. A penetration test has to run before the first customer goes live.
5. The export crashes today on an empty report, and nobody is working on it yet.

expect.criterion: tracker-scope #1: a placement request loads the skill
tracker-scope #2: a reversible technical decision is named in the change that makes it
tracker-scope #3: an owner question goes in the one standing questions issue
tracker-scope #3: an owner question carries the default that stands without objection
tracker-scope #4: a milestone check goes on the one milestone checklist
tracker-scope #5: a finding is fixed in the change at hand or dropped, never filed
expect.pattern: \bfix(ed)?\b[^\n]{0,80}\bdrop|\bdrop\b[^\n]{0,80}(no issue|rather than fil|never fil|not fil|without filing|don.t open)

expect.criterion: tracker-scope #6: an open defect stays an issue
